title: Infinite coefficient labels obstruct strictification of finite precoverages
statement: Let I be an infinite small preorder with a greatest element, C a nonempty one-object small category, F:I→Cat a strict diagram, and Q_i precoverages on F_i satisfying HasIsos and indexed IsStableUnderBaseChange. Assume all Q_i-covering presieves have finite uncurry. Let e_i:C→F_i be equivalences and v′_i:F_i→Codiscrete(I) functors. If F_ij⋙v′_j=v′_i strictly for every i≤j, and e_i⋙v′_i is the constant functor at i strictly, then False. The precoverage conventions are those of def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology.

source.place: Precoverage.HasIsos and Precoverage.IsStableUnderBaseChange, lines 85–101; counterexample to the strictification interface sourced from Categories Tag 004A

proof.text: For each i, let Y_i be the transition image of e_i(c) at the largest index. Evaluating the two strict coefficient equalities at c gives v′_top(Y_i)=i. Thus i↦Y_i is injective.
Essential surjectivity of e_top gives each Y_i as isomorphic to the image of a source object. All source objects equal c, so choose an isomorphism s_i:Y_i≅e_top(c).

The family of identity arrows on e_top(c), indexed by I, has singleton identity presieve, hence covers. For every i the square with both upper legs s_i.hom and both lower legs identity is a pullback, since s_i is invertible. Apply the indexed base-change axiom to this family. The resulting presieve of the s_i.hom is covering.
The map i↦(Y_i,s_i.hom) injects I into the uncurry of this covering. Its finiteness implies Finite I, contrary to Infinite I.

proof_origin.place: Indexed base-change axiom; explicit counterexample and Lean proof written by N2

mathlib_searches.query: In a finite precoverage stable under arbitrary indexed base change, an injective family of objects isomorphic to a fixed object is finite

theorem site_system_strictification_obstruction
    (I : Type u) [Preorder I] [OrderTop I] [Infinite I]
    (C : Type u) [SmallCategory C] [Subsingleton C] (c : C)
    (F : I ⥤ Cat.{u, u}) (Q : ∀ i : I, Precoverage (F.obj i))
    [∀ i, (Q i).HasIsos] [∀ i, (Q i).IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    (hfinite : ∀ (i : I) (X : F.obj i) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ Q i X → Finite R.uncurry)
    (e : ∀ i : I, C ⥤ F.obj i) [∀ i, (e i).IsEquivalence]
    (v' : ∀ i : I, F.obj i ⥤ Codiscrete I)
    (hstrict : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j),
      (F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor ⋙ v' j = v' i)
    (hretract : ∀ i : I, e i ⋙ v' i = Codiscrete.functor (fun _ : C ↦ i)) :
    False
